description: A second set of twelve promotion and discount questions, written BEFORE the promotion-claim policy was revised in response to the first set (eval/promotion-prompts.json), so that the revision can be checked on drafts it was not shaped by. Run with: node scripts/guardrail-fp.js --capture --prompts=eval/promotion-prompts-2.json --name=promotion-run-2

prompts.message: Any current offers I should know about?
Do you ever do clearance sales?
Is there a discount if I buy two items?
Does the store have a referral bonus?
I'm a returning customer. Do I get anything for that?
Are there any seasonal promotions coming up?
Do you price match, or is there a deal I can use instead?
Is the travel candle ever discounted?
What's the best deal you have at the moment?
Do you offer bundle deals on the scarf and the mug?
